items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I’m privileged and honored to introduce a very good friend of mine and a terrific trumpet player from New Orleans, Mr. Wendell Brunious.

ctx.x: Wendell was interviewed at the Los Angeles Classic Jazz Festival on September 3, 1995 by Michael Woods. Monk Rowe was also present for the interview.
Well I guess we’re on camera. My name is Dan Barrett and I’m privileged and honored to introduce a very good friend of mine and a terrific trumpet player from New Orleans, Mr. Wendell Brunious.

items.title: Dan Barrett interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: Dan was joined by his friend trumpet master Wendell Brunious for a conversation at the end of the interview.

ctx.x: Dan Barrett is a young instrumentalist who is keeping the tradition of classic jazz alive. He has become the premier trombonist of his generation. Since his start in the Los Angeles area in the 70s, he has performed and recorded with Benny Goodman, Woody Herman and the New York Pops Orchestra. His soloing and arranging can be heard on frequent recordings from Arbors Records. Dan was joined by his friend trumpet master Wendell Brunious for a conversation at the end of the interview.
Michael Woods interviewed Dan at the Los Angeles Classic Jazz Festival on September 3, 1995. Monk Rowe was also present for the interview.
